<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hohoho! It’s thanks to you we were able to reach this
island, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho! Look at that, <$cdef(27)>! I spy a
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center!
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,4)>But...as I suppose I should have expected, it’s gone to ruin.

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? Look, there’s a Pokémon near it!
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Right, then! First, let’s try talking to that Pokémon.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Let’s try talking to that Pokémon first!

<$comeff(4,9)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Oooh, hello! Nice to meet you! But how did you get here
when you don’t have any wings?
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>Wait—are you the kind of Pokémon who can fly even
WITHOUT wings?!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hoho! I wouldn’t be surprised if you learned how to fly
sooner or later, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hoho! I wouldn’t be surprised if you learned how to fly
sooner or later, <$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>You seem to be familiar with this town. Would you tell us
what sort of place it is? <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,8)>Are there any humans around?

<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,802)><$voicel(4,4)>Humans? No, I’ve never seen one.
<$comeff(4,5)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Oh, but there are lots ’n’ lotsa buildings and machines that
humans built around here! <$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,4)>Mostly broken ones, though.

<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Hmm, yes... And the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center is broken down too.
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>By the way, do you like this town?

<$comeff(4,8)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Yes, I LOVE it! There are lotsa different islands, and it’s
really fun to fly around between them!
<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,807)><$voicel(4,7)>This island we’re on is the biggest one. I just wish there
were more Pokémon around...

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, you’re in luck—<$cdef(27)> here is

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>And once there are more habitats in this town, more

<$comeff(4,10)><$motion(4,801)><$voicel(4,9)>Really? That’s AMAZING! Oooh, I can’t wait! And I wanna
help too!

<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hohoho! Well then, <$cdef(27)>, why don’t

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Let’s get a gander at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center PC</color>!

<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,3)>Whoa there, <$cdef(27)>—wait for me!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>I want to see that <$cdef(27)>PC too!
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hohoho! This <$cdef(27)>PC </color>seems to be in perfect working order!
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>I do hope we’ll get our hands on some more new items!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>So let’s use this <$cdef(27)>PC just like the others to improve the
environment around here!

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Just as you’ve done before, I think you ought to work on
increasing the Pokémon population here in this town too!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>And once we’ve got a lot of Pokémon around, it would be
kind of you to improve their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels as best you can.

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>It’s probably best to start out where <$cdef(27)>Rookidee suggested
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>and make Pokémon habitats here on this island where
the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center is.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,8)>But I’ll leave the method up to you. <$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>You’re already a
town-building master, after all!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>But of course you can come ask me anytime if there’s
something you’re unsure about.

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,659)><$voicel(1,9)>And they all seem to be enjoying themselves, as well! We

<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>And that all leads me to something I’d like to ask of you.
<$voicel(1,8)>Would you work together with everyone to rebuild this
town’s <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center?

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m certain it’s possible if you all work together!
<$voicel(1,8)>It may take a while, but I’ll be waiting!

<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>You might meet some new Pokémon out there.

<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,7)><$cdef(27)>Dragonite is an expert flier. If you could <$cdef(27)><$spwfull(36)> into
